p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Arrange the nonzero components in left-to-right order as a descending diagonal chain.
    from collections import deque
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            col=grid[r][c]
            if col and (r,c) not in seen:
                q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==col:
                            seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
                comps.append((min(x for y,x in cells), col, cells))
    comps.sort()
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    r=c=0; prevh=prevw=0
    for k,(_,col,cells) in enumerate(comps):
        minr=min(y for y,x in cells); minc=min(x for y,x in cells)
        h=max(y for y,x in cells)-minr+1; w=max(x for y,x in cells)-minc+1
        if k:
            r += prevh-1; c += prevw-1
        for y,x in cells:
            yy,xx=r+y-minr,c+x-minc
            if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W: out[yy][xx]=col
        prevh,prevw=h,w
    return out
'''
